authority: Key Edition 04 foundations; selected Locker A2; 19 October public-brand decision

key.name: Polaris Key
key.mark: Pinned K; Star Cut for Delivery

geometry.star: Stationary four-point motif; use each approved drawing, not a swapped or redrawn star
geometry.clearSpace: At least one quarter of visible glyph height
geometry.smallMark: Flat colour, no gradient; white star on dark; single ink in mono

key.display: Above 32 CSS px; signing bit only at 48px and above

interaction.stateCues: Text or shape as well as colour
interaction.focus: Visible focus on every actual background

motion.reducedMotion: Remove spatial movement and decorative loops
motion.authority: Reference ranges from Key Edition 04; canonical runtime motion system governs implementation

colourScope: Coral identifies Locker; violet identifies Key. Keep capability accents unchanged in either context. Bright capability swatches are display references, not universal text or control colours.

badge.padding: Preserve the complete supplied canvas and vertical space. Approved Key badge canvases retain their own proportions.

reserved.signatureRule: Gold is signature meaning, not premium or warning. No signing bit on Locker or badges.
